verses.pali: เอวัง พะหุลัง สาวะเก วิเนติ,

verses.pali: เอวัง ภาคา จะ ปะนัสสะ ภะคะวะโต สาวะเกสุ อะนุสาสะนี พะหุลา ปะวัตตะติ,

verses.paiboon: à-nʉ̀ŋ kam-sàŋ-sɔ̌ɔn kɔ̌ɔŋ prá-pûu-mii-prá-pâak-jâo nán, yɔ̂m bpen bpai nai sǎa-wók táŋ-lǎai, sùan mâak, mii sùan kʉʉ gaan jam-nɛ̂ɛk yàaŋ-níi wâa :-

vocabulary.meaning: 'we' — masculine, with the FEMININE form printed beside it in brackets. Men chant เต, women ตา. The book prints both so one page serves a mixed assembly

vocabulary.pali: โอติณณาม์หะ
vocabulary.meaning: 'we are sunk in, overwhelmed'. The Thai renders it ถูกครอบงำ — overpowered — which is what the whole passage on urgency turns on

checks.issue: ‼ THE BOOK PRINTS A BRACKETED ALTERNATIVE INSIDE THE PALI: เต (ตา) มะยัง โอติณณาม์หะ. Read at 5x. เต is the masculine 'we' and (ตา) the feminine, so the same printed line serves men and women in one assembly. Reproduced exactly, brackets included — this is the FIRST bracketed variant to appear inside a chanted Pali line in this run, as distinct from the bracketed invitations and rubrics. The Thai translation below it is not doubled; only the Pali is.

TEN VERSES SET AS TWO PARALLEL FIVES. Verses 25-29 run the five aggregates against อะนิจจา, and 30-34 run the SAME five against อะนัตตา. All ten were read off the sheet separately rather than copied; the Thai differs only in ไม่เที่ยง against ไม่ใช่ตัวตน.
THE COLON-DASH :- APPEARS AGAIN, in the Thai of verse 24 — …อย่างนี้ว่า :- — introducing the list that follows, exactly as on page 200. Kept with its space.
CUT AT THE PAGE TURN. Verse 40 is the last thing on the sheet and the chant runs on to page 202. No […] is used: it ends at a comma the book itself prints.
